question: Show all the different invoice ids and statuses of the payments
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "invoices" AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(invoice_id AS VARCHAR) AS invoice_id FROM table_1
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "payments" AS SELECT CAST(payment_id AS VARCHAR) AS payment_id, CAST(column AS VARCHAR) AS column, CAST(value AS VARCHAR) AS value FROM table_2
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "payments" AS SELECT CAST(payment_id AS VARCHAR) AS payment_id, CAST("column" AS VARCHAR) AS "column", CAST(value AS VARCHAR) AS value FROM table_2
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "invoices" AS WITH base AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(invoice_id AS VARCHAR) AS invoice_id FROM invoices) SELECT invoice_id, 'columns' AS columns FROM base
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "payments" AS SELECT payment_id, "column", value, 'columns' AS columns FROM payments

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH pay AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(payment_id AS VARCHAR) AS invoice_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN value LIKE '%-%' THEN SPLIT_PART(value, '-', 2)
      ELSE value
    END AS payment_status
  FROM payments
  WHERE lower(column) = 'invoice_payment'
), base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(invoice_id AS VARCHAR) AS invoice_id FROM invoices
  UNION 
  SELECT DISTINCT invoice_id FROM pay
)
SELECT b.invoice_id, COALESCE(p.payment_status, 'unknown') AS payment_status
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN pay p USING (invoice_id)
ORDER BY b.invoice_id

S:
